message.content: Based on the conversation, Li Hua prefers to drink a protein shake after his workout sessions. Specifically, Jennifer Moore suggests that Li Hua should focus on taking a protein shake after his workouts for optimal recovery. She recommends a post-workout protein shake as it allows the muscles to absorb the protein effectively within the 30-60 minute window following exercise. Li Hua is advised to keep the shake light before workouts, emphasizing hydration over protein intake before exercise. No preference for a pre-workout protein shake was noted in the discussions.
